title: GitHub Copilot users see token-based price hikes
summary: GitHub Copilot transitioned from flat-rate monthly subscriptions to token-based billing in April, causing price uncertainty among individual users and organizations. Users experienced price increases with the new usage-based model compared to the previous fixed-rate subscription.
problem_solved: GitHub Copilot addressed the need for more granular, usage-based pricing instead of fixed subscriptions for AI coding assistance services.
why_valuable: This billing model change reflects a broader industry trend toward usage-based pricing for AI services, helping organizations understand cost implications of AI-powered development tools.
